title: Space control & transshipment analyst em são paulo (RN)
description:
Main responsibilities and assignments:

Connection Planning & Management:

- Review, plan and coordinate vessel connection schedules with Space Control (SPC) to ensure timely transshipment execution and prevent operational complications.

- Monitor regional ports to guarantee compliance with connection standards, taking into account cargo priorities and port capacity.

- Evaluate and propose strategies to mitigate risks and reduce dwell time at transshipment ports.

Operational Monitoring & Coordination:

- Provide consolidated operational reports, identifying critical ports or regional trends that require special attention.

- Share transshipment projections with Marketing/Pricing team to monitor cargo trends across different ports

- Monitor cargo flow (TS) volumes in all LAM ports

- Coordinate with Local offices to implement necessary cargo adjustments (in case of overbookings, move count restrictions or other operational restrictions).

Booking Validation & Routing:

- Verify routing logic for bookings

- Control and manage bottlenecks to proactively advise on potential delays or service capacity increases

- Analyze and coordinate with SPC recovery plan for vessels, including necessary adjustments like skip ports or additional cargo discharge.

KPI & Regulatory Compliance:

- Measure and report the cargo dwell time across LAM ports and status of any existing operational backlog

- Alert Procurement team related issues generating additional costs from terminal or carrier sources

- Maintain updated knowledge of LAM port regulations to ensure full compliance and avoid penalties or issues impacting the client experience.

Regular meetings: with Global Office, Regional Offices (other regions) and LAM countries to align Transshipment strategy.

Degree and specific knowledge: Completed Bachelor's degree (Business Adm/International Trade or similar) Advanced English - essential for seamless communication with Global Office Intermediate Spanish - to interact within Latin America Countries Previous experience with shipping or freight forwarder, ideally dealing with ship space, bookings, logistics or operations Google Sheets and KPI management

Credi Pay is created to help business grow their sales and improve their cashflow efficiency through seamless and risk-free credit offering. Become part of a forward-thinking start-up where boldness and a commitment to excellence are paramount, and your personal and professional development is at the forefront. Work alongside a dedicated team of bright individuals driven by an Olympian mindset to excel in every aspect of our operations. Together, we aim to build with velocity, utilizing innovative embedded finance strategies to expand business operations in Latin America. Experience a close and supportive work atmosphere where collaboration thrives, wise judgment guides our decisions, and you can learn, grow, and take on meaningful responsibilities.

About the job

We are looking for someone to join Credix as a Sales Engineer. You will own the technical success of client integrations, from pre-sales feasibility to production go-live, ensuring fast activation and long-term integration stability.

Responsibilities

Technical pre-sales validation: Lead technical pre-sales by validating feasibility, defining integration scope, and identifying risks before commercial commitment. Integration delivery and go-live readiness: Support sellers through implementation and testing, and act as the technical authority to approve or block go-live based on readiness criteria. Post-go-live integration reliability: Ensure the ongoing health of live integrations by owning issue triage, resolution, or escalation within 24 business hours. Feedback loop to Product and Engineering: Translate integration learnings into actionable feedback to improve platform reliability, scalability, and integration speed. Align technical decisions with commercial outcomes: Partner closely with Sales and Account Managers to ensure integrations support activation, retention, and GMV growth. Customer-facing engagement: Frequently travel to customer sites across Brazil to support integrations, technical alignment, and relationship building.

Qualifications

Strong experience working with REST APIs, including authentication, webhooks, error handling, and data modeling. Prior exposure to complex system integrations, preferably in e-commerce platforms (e.g., VTEX) or ERPs. Comfortable working with SQL to investigate integration behavior, validate data flows, and support issue triage using BI tools such as Hex or equivalent. Able to use monitoring and logging tools (e.g., Kibana or equivalent) to identify, diagnose, and communicate production integration issues. Able to produce clear, concise, and structured technical documentation for external partners and internal teams. Organized, proactive, and reliable in driving integrations forward across multiple stakeholders. Curious about customer contexts and constraints, while able to design pragmatic, repeatable integration solutions rather than one-off custom builds. Prioritizes customer success while balancing platform scalability, reliability, and long-term architectural constraints. Operates with high autonomy and ownership, demonstrating strong prioritization, self-direction, and accountability while executing against ambitious targets.

What we offer

Collaboration and team spirit thrive best in an in-office environment. Our office provides a vibrant and engaging workspace where team members can connect, innovate, and grow. With access to our offices in Sao Paulo, you'll immerse yourself in a culture of innovation and collaboration.

But that's just the beginning - here's what else we offer:

A culture of learning and experimentation: where you are encouraged to explore new ideas and technologies Competitive salary package: Your hard work deserves recognition, and we ensure you're well-rewarded for your contributions. Equity stock options plan: Be a part of our journey towards success and share in the rewards. Paid holidays: Enjoy the flexibility to recharge and rejuvenate Off-sites: Awesome team building, unforgettable memories, and adventures ensured during our team off-sites.

title: General manager, brazil em são paulo (RN)
description:
What you'll do

As the General Manager for Brazil, you will have full P& L ownership of ANTA's Brazil business, with a primary focus on market development, business expansion, and sustainable growth, with a strong emphasis on the wholesale channel.

You will lead the development of the Brazil market from an early-stage business, proactively identify and develop key commercial opportunities, build a strong local customer and distribution network, and establish the organizational and operational foundation required for long-term growth.

This is a highly entrepreneurial and hands-on role. The successful candidate will be expected to operate with a high degree of autonomy, make things happen with limited resources, and demonstrate strong commercial drive, ownership, and execution capability.

In this role, you will: Own the overall Brazil business and deliver annual business objectives, including sales, gross margin, profitability, inventory, cash flow, and market expansion targets. Develop and execute the Brazil business strategy and annual operating plan, establishing a clear path from market entry to scalable and sustainable growth. Lead wholesale business development, proactively identify, acquire, and develop key distributors, retailers, key accounts, and other commercial partners. Drive market expansion by actively identifying new customers, channels, territories, and business opportunities, and continuously growing ANTA's market presence in Brazil. Build and maintain strong relationships with key customers and business partners, leading commercial negotiations and ensuring strong execution. Develop retail and other relevant sales channels where appropriate, while building an efficient and sustainable multi-channel business model. Operate effectively in a fast-changing and resource-constrained environment, proactively solving problems, leveraging internal and external resources, and driving key initiatives from concept to execution. Build and develop the local organization and operating infrastructure across key functions, including Sales, Marketing, Operations, Finance, and Human Resources. Take full ownership of business budgeting, forecasting, inventory, cash flow, and financial performance, and continuously drive improvements in business results. Recruit, develop, motivate, and lead a high-performing local team, building a strong ownership-driven and results-oriented culture. Provide regular updates to Group and headquarters on business performance, market trends, competitive intelligence, key customers, and major business opportunities, together with clear recommendations. Ensure the Brazil business operates in full compliance with local laws, regulations, and company policies, while effectively managing business and operational risks. Undertake other duties and responsibilities as may be assigned by Management from time to time.

What you'll bring Strong commercial mindset with a proven entrepreneurial and hunter mentality . Highly proactive, hands-on, and resourceful, with the ability to build a business with limited resources and a high degree of autonomy . Strong wholesale business development capabilities, with a proven ability to identify, approach, negotiate with, and develop key customers and commercial partners. Strong leadership, decision-making, problem-solving, and stakeholder management skills. Strong strategic thinking combined with excellent execution capability and a strong sense of ownership. Deep understanding of the Brazilian market, customers, and competitive landscape. Passion for sports is a must.

Qualifications Bachelor's degree or above in Business, Management, or a related field; MBA is a plus. 15+ years of experience in business management, commercial leadership, sales leadership, or general management. Strong and proven experience in wholesale business, including distributor, retailer, key account, or channel development. Proven track record of full P& L ownership and managing overall business performance. Hands-on experience developing business and commercial networks in Brazil. Experience in retail, sporting goods, footwear/apparel, or other consumer industries is strongly preferred. Proven experience building a business, market, or organization from the ground up , particularly in a fast-growing or entrepreneurial environment. Strong track record of delivering business growth through active market development and customer acquisition. Fluent in Portuguese and English ; Mandarin Chinese is a plus.

Travel

This role is based in Brazil and requires regular travel within Brazil to develop customers, visit business partners, support market expansion, and oversee local operations. Occasional travel to ANTA Group's global headquarters may also be required.

Community Building: Foster a thriving online community of educators, providing a platform for knowledge sharing, collaboration, and best practice dissemination. About the role

The Warranty Specialist will be responsible for managing and developing warranty operations for Omoda | Jaecoo Brasil, ensuring alignment with Headquarter (HQ) standards and supporting the dealer network in all warranty-related activities. This position acts as the key interface between HQ and Brazil regarding warranty processes, policies, technical campaigns, recalls, and claim management. The professional will be responsible for implementing warranty standards across the dealer network, ensuring process compliance, improving operational efficiency, and supporting customer satisfaction objectives. The role requires strong analytical skills, organization, communication, and the ability to work closely with dealers, technical teams, HQ, and internal departments.

Key Responsibilities

Warranty Operations & Claims Management Analyze and validate warranty claims submitted by the dealer network. Ensure claims comply with HQ warranty policies and technical requirements. Submit warranty claims and supporting documentation to HQ systems. Monitor claim approval, rejection, and payment status. Manage warranty payment processes to dealerships. Support dealers in correcting claim submission errors and improving claim quality. Monitor warranty KPIs such as claim approval rate, rejection rate, claim aging, and warranty costs.

Warranty Policies & Process Implementation Develop, implement, and continuously improve warranty policies and procedures for the Brazilian market. Adapt HQ warranty standards and processes to local operations. Ensure dealer network compliance with warranty policies, documentation standards, and operational requirements. Create and maintain warranty manuals, procedures, work instructions, and operational standards. Support continuous improvement initiatives related to warranty operations.

Technical Campaigns & Recall Management Coordinate implementation of technical campaigns and field actions across the dealer network. Monitor campaign execution performance and completion indicators. Lead recall implementation and follow-up activities when applicable. Track campaign progress, vehicle completion rates, and dealer execution quality. Ensure all recalls and campaigns are performed according to HQ and legal requirements.

Dealer Support & Communication Act as the primary support contact for dealerships regarding warranty processes and policies. Clarify warranty procedures, claim requirements, and system usage. Prepare and distribute warranty bulletins, technical communications, procedures, and operational updates. Support dealers in resolving warranty-related operational issues. Maintain strong communication and relationship with dealer aftersales teams.

Documentation & Technical Literature Management Organize and maintain warranty-related documentation and technical literature, including: Warranty policies Warranty manuals Procedures Technical bulletins Campaign bulletins Recall documentation Dealer communications Ensure all documentation is updated, standardized, and accessible to the dealer network.

Training & Network Development Organize and support warranty training sessions for dealership personnel. Develop training materials related to warranty processes and claim standards. Promote dealer capability development and process standardization. Support onboarding of new dealers regarding warranty operations.

HQ Interface & Compliance Act as the operational interface between OJBR and HQ for warranty-related topics. Ensure implementation of HQ warranty standards and directives. Participate in meetings and alignment activities with HQ teams. Provide reports, feedback, and operational insights to HQ. Support audits and compliance activities related to warranty operations.

Requirements Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Business Administration, Automotive Technology, or related fields. Experience in automotive aftersales and warranty operations. Experience working with dealer networks and warranty systems. Knowledge of automotive technical processes and claim analysis. Previous experience with OEM warranty processes is highly desirable. Knowledge of automotive warranty processes and claim management. Experience with DMS/IDMS or similar warranty systems. Advanced Excel and reporting skills. Ability to manage technical documentation and operational procedures. Understanding of technical campaigns and recall processes.

Languages English: Advanced (mandatory for communication with HQ), mandarin is a plus

Experience with KPIs Warranty claim approval rate Claim processing lead time Warranty claim rejection reduction Dealer compliance with warranty standards Technical campaign completion rate Recall completion performance Dealer satisfaction related to warranty support Warranty cost control and reporting accuracy

Additional Information Frequent interaction with dealerships and HQ teams. Occasional travel for dealer visits, audits, and training activities.

title: Principal ai engineer (agentic systems) em são paulo (RN)
description:
Missão do Cargo

Buscamos uma pessoa para construir a próxima geração de sistemas inteligentes da companhia.

Esse profissional atuará na fronteira entre pesquisa aplicada, engenharia e produto, criando mecanismos de contexto, raciocínio, memória, uso de ferramentas, interação multimodal e atuação autônoma.

Não procuramos alguém limitado a integrar APIs ou operar frameworks existentes. Esperamos uma pessoa capaz de compreender como os modelos funcionam, investigar seus limites e criar soluções originais para problemas que ainda não possuem uma resposta estabelecida.

Responsabilidades e atribuições Conceber e implementar capacidades centrais de sistemas agênticos, incluindo contexto, memória, planejamento, raciocínio, uso de ferramentas e execução autônoma; Transformar avanços recentes em modelos de linguagem e IA multimodal em experiências concretas para clientes e áreas de negócio; Conduzir ciclos rápidos de pesquisa aplicada, formulando hipóteses, construindo protótipos, criando avaliações e usando os resultados para orientar a evolução das soluções; Investigar o comportamento dos modelos, incluindo falhas de raciocínio, alucinações, conflitos de contexto, uso inadequado de ferramentas e degradação em interações longas; Projetar sistemas de contexto capazes de distinguir informações observadas, inferidas, contraditórias, desatualizadas ou desconhecidas; Construir arquiteturas de agentes que operem sobre sistemas reais com identidade, autorização, rastreabilidade, limites de autonomia e participação humana proporcional ao risco; Definir mecanismos de avaliação para medir qualidade, utilidade, segurança, confiabilidade, latência e custo; Desenvolver a infraestrutura ao redor dos modelos, incluindo roteamento, fallback, cache, observabilidade, recuperação de contexto e integração com ferramentas; Trabalhar com interações multimodais e em tempo real, como voz, texto, imagem e interfaces geradas dinamicamente; Acompanhar pesquisas recentes, reproduzir abordagens relevantes e decidir com critério o que deve ou não ser incorporado ao produto; Ser uma referência técnica para outros profissionais, elevando a qualidade das discussões e formando pessoas capazes de desenvolver sistemas de IA; Influenciar decisões de produto e negócio a partir de uma compreensão profunda das possibilidades e limitações da tecnologia.

Requisitos e qualificações Ensino Superior Completo em Tencologia ou áreas correlatas. Histórico de construção de sistemas complexos de IA, preferencialmente partindo de problemas pouco estruturados ou sem soluções prontas; Domínio de Python e fundamentos sólidos de engenharia de software, arquitetura distribuída, concorrência, APIs e sistemas orientados a eventos; Compreensão profunda de modelos de linguagem: transformers, tokenização, embeddings, atenção, janelas de contexto, inferência, sampling e uso de ferramentas; Experiência com sistemas agênticos, incluindo planejamento, memória, orquestração, execução de ferramentas e gerenciamento de estado; Capacidade de criar avaliações e experimentos que permitam comparar abordagens e compreender falhas dos modelos; Experiência em transformar protótipos de IA em sistemas operáveis, observáveis e confiáveis; Conhecimento sobre segurança aplicada a LLMs e agentes, incluindo prompt injection, vazamento de dados, abuso de ferramentas e ações não autorizadas; Capacidade de ler trabalhos científicos, avaliar suas premissas e reproduzir abordagens relevantes; Facilidade para transitar entre pesquisa, código, arquitetura, produto e estratégia; Comunicação técnica clara, sem depender de simplificações superficiais.

Diferenciais: Experiência com treinamento, pós-treinamento ou adaptação de modelos; Conhecimento de Py Torch, JAX ou frameworks equivalentes; Experiência com otimização de inferência, serving de modelos, GPUs, quantização e redução de latência; Construção de sistemas multimodais ou de interação em tempo real; Experiência com interpretabilidade, avaliações de segurança, red teaming ou alinhamento de modelos; Participação em publicações, benchmarks, comunidades técnicas ou projetos open source; Experiência com modelos em português ou adaptação de modelos para contextos culturais e linguísticos específicos; Criação de protocolos ou mecanismos de interoperabilidade entre agentes, ferramentas e sistemas; Experiência em ambientes de pesquisa aplicada ou produtos de tecnologia desenvolvidos do zero.

O QUE OFERECEMOS? Alelo Alimentação e Alelo Refeição; Benefícios de mobilidade para modelo de trabalho híbrido (Vale Transporte, Reembolso de fretado, Vale combustível e Pedágio); Alelo Cultura; Previdência Privada; PPR; Assistência Médica e Odontológica Bradesco Saúde; Auxílio creche/babá; Zenklub; Gympass/Wellhub; Total Pass; Seguro de Vida; Premiações com Pontos Livelo, além de descontos em nossos produtos; Incentivo Educação (pós-graduação, MBA e cursos de inglês) após 1 ano de empresa; Day Off para o colaborador no mês do aniversário e meio day off no aniversário do filho(a); Happy Friday (nas sextas-feiras saímos 1h mais cedo) e Summer Friday (e nas sextas-feiras de verão, 4h mais cedo); Espaço massagem, manicure e barbearia; Cafés e frutas no escritório; Programa de Reconhecimento; Ambiente de trabalho criativo, desafiador e descontraído reconhecido como uma das melhores empresas para se trabalhar pela GPTW 2026.

title: Gerente de produção em natal (RN)
description:
Gerente de Produção – Center Massas (Natal/RN)

Sobre a empresa

A Center Massas é uma indústria de panificação com 26 anos de história no mercado potiguar, produzindo pão de forma, pão de hambúrguer, hot dog e bisnaguinha. Somos uma empresa tradicional que vive um momento de profissionalização e crescimento: estamos estruturando processos, indicadores e lideranças para ganhar escala com organização. Buscamos um(a) Gerente de Produção para liderar essa evolução no chão de fábrica.

Sobre a vaga

O(a) Gerente de Produção será o principal responsável pelo desempenho da fábrica, respondendo diretamente ao Diretor Industrial. Vai liderar os Encarregados de Produção e, por meio deles, uma equipe de mais de 30 colaboradores entre operadores de máquina, mestres de padaria, forneiros e auxiliares, distribuídos em duas linhas (Forma, de dia, e Lanche, à noite) que juntas operam em um ciclo de aproximadamente 24 horas.

Principais responsabilidades Garantir o cumprimento do plano de produção com volume, qualidade, custo e prazo, do preparo da massa à embalagem. Liderar, desenvolver e dar respaldo aos Encarregados de Produção, fortalecendo a autoridade deles perante a equipe. Implantar e acompanhar indicadores de produção (rendimento, perdas, produtividade, paradas) e conduzir a rotina de reuniões de gestão. Tratar problemas com método: analisar causas, montar planos de ação e acompanhar até a solução. Padronizar a operação com POPs, checklists de passagem de turno e 5 S. Atuar em conjunto com Qualidade, Manutenção/PCM, PCP, Compras e Logística para garantir o fluxo da fábrica. Assegurar o cumprimento das Boas Práticas de Fabricação (BPF) e das normas de segurança do trabalho. Identificar oportunidades de melhoria contínua e redução de desperdícios.

Formação e requisitos Formação superior em Engenharia de Alimentos, Engenharia de Produção, Tecnologia de Alimentos ou áreas afins. Conhecimento em gestão da produção, indicadores de desempenho e ferramentas de melhoria contínua (PDCA, 5 S, análise de causa). Conhecimento em BPF e legislação sanitária aplicável à indústria de alimentos. Domínio de Excel e familiaridade com sistemas ERP. Preferência: experiência em gestão de produção na indústria de alimentos, especialmente panificação ou processos contínuos.

Competências e qualidades pessoais Liderança firme e respeitosa, que forma líderes em vez de centralizar decisões. Presença no chão de fábrica e disposição para acompanhar diferentes horários da operação quando necessário. Comunicação clara com equipes operacionais e com a direção. Organização, disciplina e foco em resultado. Postura de quem traz o problema junto com a proposta de solução. Perfil para ambientes em transformação: capacidade de implantar processos em uma empresa que está se estruturando.

O que esperamos do profissional Alguém que assuma a produção como dono do resultado, construa uma equipe de liderança forte e ajude a Center Massas a crescer com processos sólidos, sem perder a qualidade que construiu a marca ao longo de mais de duas décadas.

necessários.

6. Suporte Gerência e Diretoria

Dar suporte interno sobre os impactos atuariais que envolvem os cálculos de benefícios, contribuições e quaisquer outras questões pertinentes aos regulamentos dos planos.

Credit Saison Brazil (“CSBR”) is part of Credit Saison Group, which has Credit Saison Co. Ltd. (Japan) as ultimate parent and Saison International (Singapore) as its international headquarter. So, if you're passionate about making positive impacts in the finance sector while working in a multi-cultural environment, we want to hear from you. Join us on this exciting journey, where your talent can make a meaningful difference and together, let's contribute to the future of finance in Brazil.

B.) with active OAB registration; Fluency in both Portuguese and English; Experience leading legal due diligence processes on investee entities and counterparties; Experience structuring credit products and drafting core contractual documentation; Capability to review, validate, and approve external transaction documents, legal opinions, and memoranda covering commercial and regulatory risks; Experience drafting corporate policies, creating legal execution playbooks, and conducting in-house training sessions; Demonstrated ability to manage relationships with external partners, including selecting, negotiating fees, and evaluating the performance of law firms, fund administrators, and fund managers.

This is a consultative, relationship-led sales role requiring someone who can operate confidently across different cultures, markets, and levels of seniority.

You will be expected to understand market dynamics, identify commercial opportunities, analyse competitor activity, forecast sales accurately, and translate strategy into measurable revenue growth. The role involves approximately 40% international travel, including the potential for 2–3 weeks away from home at a time, depending on business requirements.

If you are an experienced international sales professional who enjoys developing markets, working through distribution partners, and delivering measurable commercial results, this is an opportunity to take ownership of a significant international territory within a growing global healthcare business.

Responsibilities – What you’ll be doing Managing a portfolio of international distributor and channel partners across Brazil and assigned South American markets. Developing and executing distributor and country-level business plans to achieve agreed sales targets. Taking ownership of assigned territories and identifying opportunities for revenue growth and increased market penetration. Delivering monthly, quarterly, half-yearly, and annual sales targets. Building strong, commercially focused relationships with distributors, healthcare customers, clinicians, educators, and key stakeholders. Supporting distributors to increase product penetration, customer reach, and market share. Developing smaller accounts and resellers into stronger, higher-value distribution partners. Identifying, recruiting, and onboarding new distributors across assigned territories. Supporting new product launches and market-entry strategies. Developing annual territory plans based on market trends, healthcare developments, customer needs, and commercial opportunities. Monitoring competitor activity, pricing, market positioning, and emerging trends. Providing accurate and timely sales forecasts to support business planning. Monitoring distributor performance against agreed KPIs, budgets, and revenue targets. Identifying commercial risks and opportunities and taking appropriate corrective action. Providing product training and commercial guidance to distributor sales teams. Sharing sales best practice and international market knowledge with distribution partners. Supporting distributors with sales collateral, product positioning, marketing campaigns, and product launches. Representing the organization at international conferences, exhibitions, and industry events. Ensuring products are accurately positioned and represented across distributor websites and sales channels. Essential Minimum 5 years’ experience in international channel sales, distributor management, or partner sales. Proven experience independently managing an international region or territory. Demonstrable track record of achieving sales targets and delivering measurable revenue growth. Strong experience working with distributors, channel partners, or reseller networks. Experience developing new markets and launching products within international territories. Strong commercial planning, sales forecasting, and territory management skills. Comfortable working with sales budgets, targets, KPIs, and commercial data. Strong competitor analysis and market intelligence capability. Excellent relationship-building and stakeholder management skills. Ability to present confidently to audiences ranging from C-suite executives to sales teams and end users. Excellent written and spoken Portuguese, Spanish, English, Strong organizational and time-management skills. Comfortable working independently and taking ownership of a territory. Willingness and ability to undertake significant international travel, approximately 40% of working time. Comfortable being away from home for extended international trips, potentially 2–3 weeks at a time.

Desirable

Medical Technology / Med Tech Medical Devices Healthcare Technology Medical Equipment Medical Simulation Clinical Skills Training Life Sciences Diagnostics Laboratory Equipment Healthcare Education Technology Working within a start-up, scale-up, or entrepreneurial environment. Salesforce or another CRM system. Developing distributor sales teams through product and commercial training. Transitioning reseller relationships into formal distributor partnerships. Working across emerging and established international markets.

Language Requirements (non negotiable) 1st price Fluent Portuguese Fluent business level Spanish is essential Fluent business-level English is essential.

Education & Qualifications Degree-level qualification preferred. A qualification or professional background in Nursing, Medicine, Healthcare, Life Sciences, or a related field would be advantageous. Equivalent commercial experience will also be considered.

The Profile We’re Looking For Mature, experienced, and commercially confident. Comfortable owning and managing an international region. An experienced international traveller with strong exposure to different markets and cultures. Highly capable of building and maintaining distributor relationships. Commercially analytical and comfortable working with numbers, targets, budgets, and forecasts. A fast learner who can quickly understand new products, markets, customers, and competitive environments. Confident working autonomously while knowing when to escalate issues. Professional and articulate, with strong presentation and communication skills. Highly organized with excellent time-management skills. Resilient and adaptable in a fast-moving international environment.

International travel will form a significant part of the position, at approximately 40% of working time. Travel may include extended international trips of 2–3 weeks at a time, as well as conferences, exhibitions, distributor meetings, product launches, and customer visits.

Pay & Benefits – What we offer Very Competitive salary package. Full-time, permanent opportunity based in Brazil. Opportunity to work with a growing international healthcare and medical technology business. Significant ownership of an international territory and distributor portfolio. Exposure to global healthcare markets, clinicians, educators, and international commercial partners. International travel and participation in industry conferences and events. Opportunity to contribute directly to international market expansion and revenue growth. Career development within a growing global commercial team. Collaborative and commercially focused international working environment.

Segunda a sexta-feira: das 8h às 17h30, com 1h30 de intervalo para almoço. / Sábado: das 9h às 13h.

Procuramos um profissional com olhar técnico, atenção aos detalhes e senso de responsabilidade sobre aquilo que será liberado para fabricação.

Mais do que elaborar desenhos, esse profissional terá participação importante na prevenção de erros, conferência das informações recebidas, aproveitamento adequado dos materiais, planejamento de corte, identificação das peças, controle de estoque e organização do fluxo entre medição e produção.

title: Regional president - latin america em são paulo (RN)
description:
The Opportunity

A leading international provider of testing, inspection, laboratory and life sciences services is seeking a senior executive to lead and accelerate the next phase of its Latin American business.

This is a newly formalized regional leadership position with responsibility for a multi-country platform generating approximately €60–70 million in annual revenue , with its principal operations currently concentrated in Brazil, Chile and Colombia .

The successful candidate will take ownership of the regional strategy, performance and development agenda, acting as the senior bridge between the Latin American businesses and the Group's European executive leadership.

This is a CEO-level operating mandate within a larger international organization. The successful individual will be expected to operate with significant autonomy, make independent investment and resource-allocation decisions, lead senior country teams and develop the platform through a combination of organic growth, operational improvement and strategic M& A .

The business is entering an important period of development, with an initial focus on expansion and acquisitions across Latin America followed by increasing emphasis on integration, optimization and consolidation.

The Business

The Latin American platform operates primarily across food testing and laboratory services , with additional activities spanning areas including: Agriculture and agri-food Biopharmaceutical and life sciences Clinical and diagnostic services Environmental testing Genomics and related scientific services Other specialized laboratory and technical services

The organization operates through a decentralized and highly entrepreneurial model, with technically strong local teams and established operations across multiple countries.

The opportunity is to connect these businesses more effectively at a regional level while preserving the local expertise and entrepreneurial culture that underpin their success.

The Role

The Regional President will have broad responsibility for the strategy, P& L, growth, operational performance and organizational development of the Latin American platform .

The role will work closely with country leadership teams and senior Group executives in Europe, while providing a clear regional perspective on investment, acquisitions, market development and organizational priorities.

The position is expected to evolve as the wider regional leadership structure develops, but the successful candidate will operate at approximately CEO-2 level within the broader Group structure and will have substantial exposure to the executive committee.

Key responsibilities

Regional Strategy & Leadership Define and execute the medium- and long-term strategy for the Latin American business. Establish clear priorities across Brazil, Chile, Colombia and other markets within the regional portfolio. Identify opportunities to expand the platform organically and through strategic investment. Act as the principal link between Latin American operations and European Group leadership. Develop a cohesive regional leadership culture while maintaining appropriate local autonomy.

P& L & Operational Management Hold overall responsibility for the regional P& L and financial performance. Drive revenue growth, profitability, cash generation and return on invested capital. Allocate resources and capital across countries and business lines according to strategic priorities. Ensure operational performance, service quality and customer development remain aligned with regional objectives. Establish appropriate performance metrics and accountability across the country portfolio.

M& A & Business Development Lead the identification and evaluation of acquisition opportunities across Latin America. Develop acquisition strategies aligned with the broader regional growth plan. Work closely with Group M& A, finance and executive leadership on due diligence, valuation and investment decisions. Lead or oversee post-acquisition integration and organizational alignment. Identify opportunities for consolidation and platform-building within fragmented markets. Balance acquisition-led expansion with organic development and operational optimization.

Organizational Development Lead and develop senior country and functional leadership teams. Establish the organizational structure required to support the next phase of regional growth. Build stronger collaboration and knowledge-sharing between countries. Identify and develop future regional and country leadership talent. Operate effectively within a decentralized, matrixed international organization.

Stakeholder Management Build strong relationships with European executive leadership and Group functions. Represent the Latin American business at senior executive level. Develop relationships with major customers, partners, regulators and other external stakeholders. Navigate differing regulatory, cultural and commercial environments across multiple Latin American markets.

Candidate Profile

The ideal candidate will be an experienced regional CEO, President, Managing Director or senior General Manager who has previously operated with broad commercial, operational and financial responsibility across Latin America.

We are particularly interested in executives who combine regional P& L ownership with strategic and M& A experience .

Essential experience

Significant senior leadership experience across Latin America , ideally with responsibility for multiple countries. Demonstrable experience managing a substantial P& L and full business performance. Experience operating at CEO, President, Regional MD or comparable level. Strong strategic planning and capital-allocation experience. Meaningful experience with M& A, acquisitions and post-acquisition integration . Experience developing businesses through both organic growth and inorganic expansion. Proven ability to operate across different cultures, regulatory environments and business models. Experience leading senior management teams across geographically dispersed operations. Strong commercial and financial acumen.

Preferred background

Experience in one or more of the following environments would be highly relevant:

Testing, Inspection & Certification Laboratory services Food testing / food safety Environmental testing Life sciences / biopharma services Clinical or diagnostic services Agriculture and agri-food services Technical or scientific services Other decentralized B2 B services businesses with comparable complexity

Direct experience in testing or laboratory services is advantageous but not essential for the right regional operator.

Leadership Characteristics

The successful candidate will be a highly autonomous and commercially minded leader who is comfortable operating without unlimited resources or centralized support.

They will demonstrate:

Entrepreneurial leadership – able to build and develop a regional platform rather than simply manage an established structure. Strategic thinking – able to translate a broad regional opportunity into a practical investment and growth strategy. Financial discipline – comfortable owning a P& L, allocating capital and making difficult investment decisions. M& A orientation – able to identify, assess and integrate businesses as part of a broader consolidation strategy. Operational credibility – capable of engaging with technical and operational leaders while maintaining a strategic perspective. Cultural intelligence – comfortable leading across different Latin American countries and working with European stakeholders. Decisiveness – comfortable making independent decisions within a complex matrix environment. Influence – able to align decentralized businesses and senior stakeholders without relying solely on formal authority.

Location & Travel

São Paulo is the preferred location , reflecting the scale and strategic importance of the Brazilian business.

Candidates based elsewhere in Latin America, including Buenos Aires, Santiago or other major regional hubs , may also be considered where the leadership profile is particularly strong.

The position will involve regular travel across Latin America and interaction with senior European leadership, including stakeholders based in Brussels and other European locations.

Compensation

A competitive executive package comprising:

Base salary Annual performance bonus Long-term incentive / LTI

The final package will be determined according to the experience and seniority of the successful candidate and the employing structure.

Selection Process

The process is expected to include:

Initial video interview with senior Group leadership. Second-stage interview with the current senior leader responsible for Latin America. Executive assessment in Brussels , involving meetings with members of the Group executive committee and relevant senior stakeholders. Finance / P& L case study designed to assess financial and commercial decision-making capability.

Why This Role?

This is an opportunity for a senior executive to take genuine ownership of the development of a significant Latin American platform within a highly successful international group.

The mandate combines:

Regional CEO-level autonomy + €60–70m P& L + multi-country leadership + significant M& A + European executive exposure.

The successful candidate will have the opportunity to shape the regional organization, determine where and how the business invests, build the next generation of leadership and play a central role in the consolidation and expansion of a growing Latin American services platform.

WHY JOIN US

If you're looking for a place to grow, make an impact, and work with people who care, we'd love to meet you!

ABOUT THE ROLE

As a Product Manager , you’ll define strategy, lead teams, and deliver digital products that engage millions of users worldwide. Combining data-driven insights with market knowledge, you’ll shape product vision, mentor peers, and collaborate across functions. This role offers high impact, growth, and the chance to influence the future of digital media .

WHAT YOU WILL DO

  • Product Strategy – Develop and communicate a clear product strategy and vision for digital platforms and products, aligning it with the company’s goals and objectives
  • Product Leadership – Lead multiple product teams and drive product strategy for a larger portfolio of products.
  • Team Leadership – Lead and mentor a team of product managers, providing guidance and support to help them achieve their goals and deliver high-quality products.
  • Product Roadmap – Define and maintain the product roadmap for multiple products, ensuring it aligns with business priorities, user needs, and market trends. Make data-driven decisions and prioritize features accordingly.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration – Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including engineering, design, editorial, and marketing, to ensure successful product development and delivery.
  • User Research – Conduct and analyze user research to gain a deep understanding of user needs, preferences, and pain points. Use this data to inform product decisions and improvements.
  • User Experience (UX) – Work with UX/UI designers to create user-friendly and visually appealing products. Ensure a seamless and engaging user experience across digital platforms.
  • Data Analysis – Utilize data analytics and key performance indicators (KPIs) to monitor product performance, identify areas for improvement, and make data-driven decisions to optimize the product.
  • Product Development – Oversee the end-to-end product development process, from ideation to release. Coordinate with development teams to deliver high-quality products on schedule.
  • Project Management – Define and prioritize product features, enhancements, and requirements based on customer feedback, market research, and business impact. Collaborate with product managers to ensure that product feature prioritization aligns with the overall product strategy and roadmap.
  • Product Launch – Plan and execute successful product launches, including marketing strategies and user communication. Monitor product performance post-launch and iterate based on user feedback.
  • Stakeholder Communication – Keep stakeholders informed about the status of ongoing projects, milestones, and potential roadblocks. Maintain transparency and ensure alignment with business goals.
  • Market and Competitive Analysis – Stay informed about industry trends, emerging technologies, and the competitive landscape to identify opportunities and threats in the market.
  • User Feedback and Support – Engage with user feedback, reviews, and support channels to address user concerns, gather insights, and drive product improvements.

MUST HAVES

  • 5-7 years working on technology-powered products as either a product manager or user researcher;
  • Strong understanding of digital media platforms, technologies, and industry trends ;
  • Proven ability to build intuitive content management systems that meet both internal and external customer needs;
  • Experience in building subscription-based products with a track record of driving growth;
  • Led product development on complex features from 1st to Nth interaction;
  • A history of deep and demonstrated understanding of the techniques and methods of modern product discovery and product delivery;
  • Demonstrated ability to figure out solutions to hard problems with many constraints, using sound judgment to assess risks, and to lay out your argument in a well-structured, data-informed, written narrative;
  • Proven ability to engage with engineers, designers, and company leaders in a constructive and collaborative relationship;
  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience;
  • Upper-Intermediate English level.

NICE TO HAVES

  • Deep understanding of gaming trends;
  • Strong background in app development and design.

PERKS AND BENEFITS

  • Professional growth: Accelerate your professional journey with mentorship, TechTalks, and personalized growth roadmaps.
  • Competitive compensation: We match your ever-growing skills, talent, and contributions with competitive USD-based compensation and budgets for education, fitness, and team activities.
  • Join projects with modern solutions development and top-tier clients that include Fortune 500 enterprises and leading product brands.
  • Flextime: Tailor your schedule for an optimal work-life balance, by having the options of working from home and going to the office – whatever makes you the happiest and most productive.

CHRO l Diretor de Gente & Cultura no Group Med+ | Nem DP e Nem RH, PESSOAS!

Cargo: Médido do Trabalho

Lotação: Taquipe - São Sebastião do Passé/BA

Requisitos obrigatórios para assumir a vaga

  • Formação: Superior em Medicina, com certificado emitido por instituição reconhecida pelo MEC.
  • Situação regularizada no Conselho Regional de Medicina (CRM) da respectiva localidade em que atua.
  • Título de Especialista em Medicina do Trabalho pela Associação Médica Brasileira ou Certificação de Residência Médica em Medicina do Trabalho ou Curso de Especialização em Medicina do Trabalho, reconhecido pelo MEC.
  • Conhecimento e/ou experiência comprovada nos conceitos de atendimento em saúde do trabalhador dentro de organizações.
  • Treinamento em Biossegurança ou NR32.
  • Possuir habilidades nos sistemas informatizados, incluindo pacote office, dentre outros sistemas utilizados pela Petrobras.
  • Possuir habilidades profissionais para trabalho em equipe, flexibilidade, proatividade, organização e comprometimento.
  • Experiência mínima de acima de 6 (seis) anos na atividade de médico do trabalho.
  • Desejável experiência mínima de 2 (dois) anos como responsável pelo PCMSO.

Descrição das atividades

  • Realizar exame clínico e analisar exames complementares e/ou pareceres recebidos, para avaliação da saúde do empregado e definição da capacidade laborativa / aptidão para a função;
  • Realizar exames médicos ocupacionais, contemplando os desdobramentos pertinentes, inclusive encaminhamentos internos e externos, bem como negociação de atividades laborativas compatíveis com possíveis restrições ou limitações com as lideranças;
  • Realizar avaliação de saúde pré e pós viagem;
  • Realizar avaliação médica e/ou participar de junta multidisciplinar para avaliação de enquadramento de Pessoa com Deficiência (PCD) para integrar cota;
  • Elaborar e registrar no sistema informatizado laudo de transferência para fins de Exame Médico de Mudança de Riscos Ocupacionais, com definição de realização de exames complementares, caso necessário;
  • Avaliar a capacidade laborativa e homologar atestados médicos dos considerados totalmente incapazes para o trabalho, registrando os dados clínicos e suas impressões, bem como as licenças médicas aplicáveis no Sistema Informatizado de Saúde, realizando os desdobramentos necessários;
  • Realizar exame pericial para homologação presencial de atestado médico;
  • Acompanhar empregados afastados em benefício previdenciário, assim como fazer visitas domiciliares, hospitalares e/ou ao INSS quando necessário;
  • Avaliar as condições de saúde do empregado, com o objetivo de identificar possibilidades de reinserção em atividade laboral compatível com o estado de saúde ou agravos potenciais à saúde, e definir estratégias de intervenção;
  • Elaborar laudo médico justificando a necessidade de manutenção do afastamento e prognóstico, em caso de inaptidão ao trabalho;
  • Emitir pareceres e/ou relatórios acerca das conclusões referentes à capacidade laborativa e/ou incapacidades temporárias parciais que impliquem na mudança do regime de trabalho ou das atividades exercidas, descrevendo as restrições para determinadas atividades laborativas, bem como suas causas e prazos para reavaliação médica;
  • Investigar e estabelecer nexo-causal em parceria com o profissional da PETROBRAS;
  • Preencher CAT no Sistema Informatizado de Saúde, bem como emitir os comunicados cabíveis às partes envolvidas (internas e externas à Companhia) em relação ao processo de Gestão de Anomalias e Acidentes de Trabalho, além de atuação na classificação e caracterização de ocorrências, de acordo com normas e diretrizes da PETROBRAS;
  • Analisar as causas de absenteísmo por doença ou acidente do órgão operacional;
  • Participar de atendimentos e inspeções de saúde nas áreas operacionais;
  • Avaliar condições de trabalho dos acidentados em conjunto com o próprio acidentado e com a comissão de investigação de acidentes, quando demandado, seguindo os procedimentos internos;
  • Realizar visita médica hospitalar ou domiciliar a empregados, se demandado, emitir relatório pós visita e registrar dados no prontuário eletrônico.
  • Participar de junta médica para conclusão de avaliação clínica;
  • Atuar em equipe multiprofissional, acompanhamento individual interdisciplinar em saúde e atuar como matriciador na discussão técnica dos casos acompanhados;
  • Realizar análise das condições de trabalho, relações sociais, orientação e encaminhamento para Programas de Saúde e Serviço Social;
  • Realizar interface com médico assistente para adequado subsídio nas avaliações pertinentes ao médico do trabalho, quando necessário;
  • Desenvolver ações estruturadas, integradas aos diversos programas desenvolvidos na Companhia;
  • Elaborar relatórios e painéis gerenciais de planejamento e apoiar na apuração dos indicadores, utilizando os sistemas e ferramentas de gestão da PETROBRAS;
  • Formular pareceres técnicos sobre assuntos de sua especialidade, prestando assessoramento às gerências da PETROBRAS, quando demandado;
  • Realizar análise crítica de registros em prontuário médico com elaboração de resumos e/ou relatórios, inclusive contestação de nexo causal, entre outros solicitados pela equipe da PETROBRAS;
  • Assessorar, planejar, gerir e realizar consolidação e análise crítica de dados;
  • Propor, planejar e executar atividades coletivas, promovendo espaços de diálogo e utilizando estratégias adequadas para sensibilização, engajamento e protagonismo dos trabalhadores;
  • Transcrever para o Sistema Informatizado da Petrobras o registro de exames ocupacionais realizados por profissionais externos;
  • Assumir responsabilidade técnica do serviço junto ao conselho profissional da categoria, quando necessário;
  • Registrar as informações e atendimento em formulários próprios e/ou sistemas informatizados; Atuar em atendimentos de urgências e emergências em caráter eventual com suporte às equipes de prontidão, cabendo para tal a realização de treinamentos específicos ofertados pela Petrobras;
  • Realizar as atribuições profissionais descritas na Lei nº 12.842/13 e suas alterações, Resolução CFM nº 2297/21, bem como às demais normas emitidas pelo Conselho Federal de Medicina (CFM), Conselho Regional de Medicina do Estado (CRM), Normas Regulamentadoras do Ministério do Trabalho e Emprego (NR’s) e legislação vigente aplicável.

Faça parte do nosso time!

title: Manager, Field Site LN_FR em congo (PB)
description:
RÉSUMÉ DU POSTE

La tâche principale du/de la directeur(trice) de site de terrain est de faciliter la programmation humanitaire sur un site de terrain spécifique, conformément à la conception du programme, au budget et au calendrier. Le/la directeur(trice) de site de terrain permet la mise en œuvre du programme et soutient les fonctions des programmes, de la logistique, des finances et de l'administration sur le site de terrain. Le/la directeur(trice) de site de terrain est le/la représentant(e) de la mission d’IMC sur un site terrain particulier.

Pour mener à bien ce travail, une personne doit être capable de remplir chaque fonction essentielle avec ou sans aménagements raisonnables.

PRINCIPALES TÂCHES ET RESPONSABILITÉS

Gestion des programmes

  • Contrôler la programmation en collaboration avec les responsables des départements techniques afin d'assurer une mise en œuvre rapide et efficace, conformément aux principes humanitaires, aux règles et réglementations d'IMC et aux exigences des donateurs dans la région.
  • Promouvoir un leadership positif au sein du site de terrain par le biais de réunions de coordination interne régulières et efficaces.
  • Gérer les activités de programmation pour la mise en œuvre en temps voulu de toutes les activités énumérées dans la proposition.
  • Assister les équipes dans l'élaboration et l'exécution des plans de travail.
  • Suivre les dépenses mensuelles et prévoir celles à venir en fonction des activités mises en œuvre sur les sites de terrain.
  • Coordonner les activités avec les agences de mise en œuvre dans la région afin d'éviter les doubles emplois et de combler les lacunes dans les services.
  • Informer régulièrement le bureau de pays de l'avancement des programmes, conformément au protocole, le cas échéant.
  • Avec le soutien de l'équipe MEAL du pays, veiller à ce que des systèmes de suivi et d'évaluation soient en place pour assurer l'efficacité des rapports sur le programme, en vue d'une utilisation conjointe avec le personnel du programme.
  • Veiller à la disponibilité d'informations actualisées sur la communauté affectée ciblée et coordonner les listes et numéros de bénéficiaire avec les différentes parties prenantes.
  • Veiller à ce que la mise en œuvre du programme respecte les délais, les objectifs et le budget, en utilisant les systèmes de S&E disponibles pour atteindre l'impact souhaité.
  • Veiller à ce que les données du programme soient régulièrement mises à jour.
  • Travailler avec le personnel pour soumettre des données et des rapports de qualité élevée, en temps opportun.

Gestion des ressources humaines et renforcement des capacités

  • Créer et maintenir un environnement de travail fondé sur le respect mutuel, au sein duquel les membres de l'équipe s'efforcent d'atteindre l'excellence.
  • Le cas échéant, superviser les actions logistiques et administratives des programmes sur le site de terrain.
  • Promouvoir la redevabilité, communiquer les attentes et fournir un retour d'information constructif par le biais d'évaluations des performances régulières.
  • Soutenir les ressources humaines du bureau de pays lors du recrutement et de l'orientation des nouveaux membres de l'équipe, le cas échéant, en collaboration avec la direction du programme.
  • Promouvoir une compréhension commune des règles et règlements d'IMC par le biais d'une formation continue du personnel.
  • Aider à développer les capacités du personnel et exécuter/suivre la mise en œuvre du plan.
  • Contribuer aux efforts de renforcement de l'équipe pays, aider les membres de l'équipe à identifier les options de résolution des problèmes et assurer l'intégration de tous les membres de l'équipe dans les processus décisionnels pertinents.

Suivi, évaluation, redevabilité et apprentissage

  • Intégrer les approches et activités MEAL dans les plans et opérations du programme, en décrivant comment MEAL sera mis en œuvre à chaque étape du cycle du programme.
  • Soutenir l'équipe MEAL du pays dans la mise en place du système MEAL, des outils de collecte de données et d'un mécanisme formel afin de recueillir, suivre, traiter et agir sur les retours d'information et les plaintes des communautés.
  • Veiller à ce que l'ensemble du personnel et des bénévoles reçoivent une formation de base en matière de communication et de traitement des plaintes.
  • Veiller à ce que son personnel sache comment recevoir, enregistrer et transmettre (au CBFRM) les retours d’information et les plaintes, s’il est contacté par un membre de la communauté.
  • S'assurer que son personnel sait comment donner un consentement éclairé de base (en expliquant ce qu'il advient des retours d'information/plaintes, le calendrier, les différentes façons de contacter IMC, comment/quand recevoir une réponse d’IMC, les droits/limites concernant les plaintes anonymes, etc.).
  • Sur la base des résultats, des enseignements, des retours d'information et des données d'évaluation générés par le système MEAL, identifier et utiliser les meilleures approches pour fournir aux communautés des activités et des informations pertinentes et exploitables en matière de préservation et amélioration des conditions de vie.

Sécurité

  • Travailler en étroite collaboration avec les équipes de gestion de la sécurité et le/la DP pour garantir l'élaboration de procédures opérationnelles standard pour les zones d'opérations des sites de terrain. Aider à la révision des plans de sécurité.
  • Veiller à ce que le personnel connaisse les procédures opérationnelles standard et soit en mesure de les suivre.
  • Comprendre et surveiller les changements dans l'environnement et alerter les directeur(trice)s de la sécurité.
  • Développer un réseau pour obtenir des informations pertinentes en matière de sécurité. Développer de bons contacts pour vérifier les changements contextuels.

Représentation

  • Promouvoir le travail d’IMC et assurer la liaison avec les parties prenantes externes concernées, les dirigeants locaux et les représentants du gouvernement.
  • Générer une image positive d'IMC et de son personnel sur le site de terrain.
  • Représenter IMC auprès des Nations unies et de la communauté des ONG et établir des partenariats de collaboration avec les partenaires des ONG, les bénéficiaires de subventions et les autres parties prenantes.

Effectuer les autres tâches qui lui sont confiées. Les fonctions et responsabilités énumérées dans le présent document sont représentatives de la nature et du volume du travail assigné et ne sont pas nécessairement exhaustives.

Qualifications Minimales

  • Généralement, une licence dans un domaine connexe est souhaitée. Une combinaison équivalente de formation et d'expérience pertinentes peut être acceptée, le cas échéant.
  • Généralement, 5 ans ou plus d'expérience pertinente et progressive dans la gestion de projets et de personnel d'ONG dans des contextes humanitaires ou de développement, dont au moins 2 ans d'expérience internationale dans un rôle de gestion des opérations.
  • Expérience en gestion de projets dans le secteur humanitaire.
  • Connaissance des opérations humanitaires internationales, des structures de coordination et des mandats des donateurs, des agences des Nations unies et d'autres ONG.
  • Bonne compréhension de la gestion financière et de la planification stratégique.
  • Compréhension et capacité à travailler dans un environnement instable et multiculturel (sensibilité culturelle).
  • Profonde sensibilité interculturelle et compréhension des questions de soins de santé.
  • Capacité à faire preuve de discernement et à prendre des décisions de manière indépendante, extrêmement flexible et capable de faire face à des situations stressantes et à des frustrations.
  • Capacité à établir des relations avec le personnel et à le motiver avec efficacité.
  • Créativité et capacité à travailler avec des ressources limitées.
  • Excellentes aptitudes à la prise de décision, esprit d'équipe et solides compétences en matière de communication, tant à l'oral qu'à l'écrit.
  • Maîtrise des applications informatiques, en particulier MS Word et MS Excel, MS PowerPoint.

Job Summary

The Field Site Manager’s primary duty is to facilitate humanitarian programming at a specific field site location according to program design, budget and timeline. The Field Site Manager enables program implementation and supports the functions of programs, logistics, finance, and administration at the field site location. The Field Site Manager is the representative of the IMC mission in that particular field location.

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential function with or without reasonable accommodation.

Main Tasks And Responsibilities

Program Management

  • Monitor programming in collaboration with technical departments leads to assure timely and efficient implementation in accordance with humanitarian principles, IMC rules and regulations and donor requirements in the area.
  • Promote positive leadership within field site through regular and efficient internal coordination meetings.
  • Manage programming activities for timely implementation of all activities listed in the proposal.
  • Assist teams in the development and execution of work plans.
  • Track monthly expenditure and project future expenses in reference to activities being implemented at field sites
  • Coordinate activities with implementing agencies in the area to avoid duplication and to address gaps in service.
  • Regularly update country office on progression of programs as per protocol When applicable:
  • With support from the country MEAL team, ensure monitoring and evaluation systems are in place for effective program reporting, for use in coordination with program staff.
  • Ensure availability of up-to-date information on the affected and targeted community and coordinates beneficiary lists and numbers with different stakeholders.
  • Ensure program implementation is on time, target and budget, using available M&E systems to reach desired impact.
  • Make sure program data is updated on regular basis.
  • Work with staff to submit timely and high-quality data and reports.

Human Resources Management and Capacity Building

  • Create and sustain a work environment of mutual respect where team members strive to achieve excellence.
  • When applicable, oversee logistic and administrative actions of the programs in the field site
  • Promote accountability, communicate expectations and provide constructive feedback via regular performance reviews.
  • Support country office HR on the recruitment and orientation of new team members as necessary in collaboration with program management.
  • Promote shared understanding of IMC rules and regulations through ongoing training for staff.
  • Assist in developing staff capacity and deliver/monitor the implementation of the plan.
  • Contribute to country team-building efforts, help team members identify problem-solving options and ensure the integration of all team members into relevant decision-making processes

Monitoring, Evaluation, Accountability and Learning

  • Integrate MEAL approaches and activities into program plans and operations, outlining how MEAL will be implemented at each stage of the program cycle.
  • Support country MEAL team in establishing MEAL system, data collection tools, and a formal mechanism to capture, monitor, respond to and act on feedback and complaints from communities.
  • Ensure all staff and volunteers receive basic communication and complaint handling skills training.
  • Ensure their staff know how to receive, record, and refer (to the CBFRM) feedback and complaints should they be approached by a member of the community.
  • Ensure their staff know how to provide basic informed consent (explaining what happens to feedback/complaint, timeline, how they can contact IMC, how/when they should receive a response from IMC, rights/limitations regarding anonymous complaints, etc.).
  • Based on findings, lessons, feedback and assessment data generated from MEAL system, identify and utilize the best approaches to provide communities with relevant and actionable life-saving and life-enhancing activities and information.

Security

  • Work closely with Security Management Teams and CD to ensure that Standard Operating Procedures are developed for the field site areas of operations. Assist in the revision of security plans.
  • Ensure staffs are aware of and are able to follow standard operation procedures.
  • Understand and monitor changes in the surroundings and alert security managers to changes.
  • Develop a network to get relevant security information. Develop good contacts to cross check contextual changes.

Representation

  • Promote IMC’s work and liaise with relevant external stakeholders, local leaders and government officials.
  • Generate a positive image of IMC and its personnel in the field site location
  • Represent IMC to UN and INGO community and build collaborative partnerships with NGO partners, sub-grantees, another stakeholder.

Perform other duties as assigned. The duties and responsibilities listed in this document are representative of the nature and level of work assigned and not necessarily all inclusive.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Typically, a bachelor's degree in a related field is preferred. An equivalent combination of relevant education and experience may be substituted as appropriate.
  • Typically, 5+ years of relevant and progressive NGO project and personnel management experience in humanitarian or development contexts, including a minimum of 2 years of international work experience in an operations management role
  • Experience in project management in the humanitarian sector
  • Familiarity with international humanitarian operations, coordination structures, and the mandates of donors, UN agencies, and other NGOs
  • Good understanding of financial management and strategic planning
  • Understanding and ability to work in unstable and multi-cultural environment (cultural sensitivity)
  • Profound cross-cultural awareness and insight into health care issues,
  • Ability to, exercise sound judgment and make decisions independently, extremely flexible, and could cope with stressful situations and frustrations
  • Ability to relate to and motivate staff effectively
  • Creativity and the ability to work with limited resources
  • Excellent decision-making skills, Team player and strong communication skills, both oral and written.
  • Proficient in computer applications, especially with MS Word and MS Excel, MS PowerPoint

Bluelight is a leading software consultancy dedicated to designing and developing innovative technology that enhances users' lives. We are looking for a skilled individual to join our rapidly growing team at Bluelight. This position is ideal for someone who thrives in a fast-paced, dynamic environment where everyone's opinions and efforts are valued and appreciated. You will have the opportunity to contribute to challenging and meaningful projects, developing high-quality applications that stand out in the market. We value continuous learning, personal growth, and hard work, offering a collaborative environment that promotes professional development. If you are passionate about software development and eager to be part of a growing software consultancy, we invite you to apply and join us on this exciting journey.

About The Role

  • We are looking for a growth-focused B2B marketer with a strong foundation in paid media and marketing automation. You will be responsible for driving qualified leads to our nearshore staffing solutions using a mix of paid strategies and sophisticated HubSpot automation.
  • You will not just be "buying media", you will be owning the engine that connects innovative US companies with world-class engineering talent in Latin America. You are well-versed in Google Campaign Manager, LinkedIn Ads, and HubSpot, and you understand the nuances of marketing complex B2B services to technical decision-makers.
  • Our ideal candidate thrives on data and uses it to craft high-performing B2B campaigns. You understand that selling a partnership is different from selling a product, it requires trust, authority, and multiple touch points. You are organized, detail-oriented, and possess a "White Belt Mentality", always eager to learn and improve. Above all, you are a "Human" first, bringing a positive, engaged personality that strengthens our remote, transparency-first culture.

Key Responsibilities

  • B2B Media Planning & Strategy:
  • HubSpot Ownership: Serve as the internal subject matter expert for HubSpot. You will not just use it, but optimize it—building workflows, lead scoring models, and attribution reports that connect ad spend to closed client deals.
  • Strategic Planning: Develop comprehensive B2B media plans that target decision-makers at startups and enterprise companies who need to scale their engineering teams.
  • Market Research: Conduct deep analysis to identify where our target audience (technical leaders) consumes content and how best to reach them.
  • Innovation: Stay abreast of emerging B2B trends, AI integrations in marketing, and new channels for reaching technical talent buyers.
  • Sales Enablement: Advise the New Business and Account teams on recommended budgets and strategies to support their pipeline goals.
  • Campaign Execution & Management:
  • Multi-Channel Execution: Oversee the execution of paid media campaigns with a heavy focus on LinkedIn Ads (Account-Based Marketing) and Google Ads (High-intent search).
  • Vendor Management: Manage relationships with external vendors or agencies to ensure day-to-day execution aligns with our strategic vision.
  • Full-Funnel Analytics: Track B2B KPIs beyond just "clicks"—focusing on MQLs (Marketing Qualified Leads), SQLs (Sales Qualified Leads), Cost Per Discovery Call, and Pipeline Velocity.
  • Optimization: Analyze campaign data to identify areas for improvement, such as refining audience segments (e.g., targeting specific tech stacks like React or Python users) to improve lead quality.
  • Budget & ROI Management:
  • Budget Pacing: Manage and allocate media budgets effectively across channels to maximize Client Acquisition Cost (CAC) efficiency.
  • Forecasting: Maintain daily, weekly, and monthly budget pacing, ensuring campaigns remain on schedule and within financial targets.
  • Efficiency: Identify opportunities for cost-saving without compromising the quality of inbound leads.

Skills & Qualifications

  • 4+ years of experience in B2B performance marketing or media buying. Experience specifically in the Staffing, Recruiting, or SaaS sectors is a massive plus.
  • HubSpot Proficiency is Required: Must have deep experience with HubSpot Marketing Hub (workflows, landing pages, list segmentation) and CRM integration. HubSpot certifications are highly preferred.
  • Paid Media Expert: Strong experience in paid platforms, specifically LinkedIn Campaign Manager (for B2B targeting) and Google Ads.
  • Analytical Mindset: Proficiency in analytics and attribution tools (Google Analytics 4, HubSpot Reports, LinkedIn Insights Tag).
  • Strong Communication: Excellent interpersonal skills with the ability to explain complex marketing data to non-marketing stakeholders.
  • Self-Motivated: Able to work independently in a remote environment while maintaining close collaboration with the team.

  • Generous paid-time-off policy

  • Company-sponsored coursework, exams, and certifications

description:

Esta função combina conhecimento regulatório, validação da mecânica dos jogos e experiência em localização para adaptar os recursos do produto ao mercado brasileiro, tanto do ponto de vista técnico quanto da experiência do usuário.

Principais Responsabilidades

Regulamentação e Certificação

  • Interpretar as regulamentações brasileiras de jogos de azar (Portaria 722, Portaria 1207, etc.) e garantir que as mecânicas proprietárias dos jogos estejam em conformidade com os requisitos legais.
  • Validar modelos matemáticos, estruturas de pagamento, uso de RNG (Gerador de Números Aleatórios), lógica de jackpot; sugerir adaptações nas mecânicas de jogo e volatilidade para verificar a conformidade antes do envio aos laboratórios de certificação.
  • Preparar a documentação técnica exigida pelas entidades de certificação, incluindo regras do jogo, metodologia de RNG, divulgações de RTP (Retorno ao Jogador), tabelas de probabilidade e fluxo operacional.
  • Identificar riscos de conformidade na avaliação inicial e propor ajustes ou mecânicas alternativas para garantir a aprovação com segurança e o mínimo de retrabalho.

Lógica, Matemática e Mecânicas do Jogo

  • Revisar e validar a matemática do jogo: valor esperado, frequência de pagamento, curvas de volatilidade, distribuição de prêmios, exposição ao risco, RTP e impacto promocional.
  • Trabalhar com designers e desenvolvedores matemáticos para garantir que a lógica de probabilidade seja transparente e tecnicamente comprovável.
  • Apoiar testes A/B e simulações para verificar os resultados esperados e relatar discrepâncias.

Localização e Experiência do Usuário

  • Adaptar jogos ao mercado brasileiro sob uma perspectiva cultural e comportamental, incluindo temas visuais, elementos de UI/UX, som, terminologia e ritmo de jogo.
  • Contribuir com ideias para o design do estúdio, dublagens, apresentadores e elementos na tela, alinhados ao público local.
  • Sugerir ajustes na dificuldade do jogo, distribuição de prêmios, preços e fluxo de integração com base nos padrões de comportamento do usuário no Brasil.

Colaboração Interdepartamental

  • Atuar como elo entre as equipes de produto, desenvolvimento, estúdios, jurídico/compliance e laboratórios de certificação.
  • Traduzir requisitos técnicos e matemáticos em tarefas claras para designers e engenheiros.
  • Analisar designs de estúdio e protótipos de jogos, fornecendo feedback estruturado sobre conformidade, clareza e adequação ao mercado.

Procuramos Alguém Que Tenha

  • Experiência com design e desenvolvimento de jogos, matemática aplicada a jogos (RTP, RNG, volatilidade, modelagem de probabilidade) e/ou processos de certificação.
  • Sólido conhecimento dos mercados regulamentados de iGaming, idealmente o Brasil.
  • Capacidade de ler e interpretar normas legais e transformá-las em decisões práticas de produto.
  • Pensamento analítico e habilidades de documentação estruturada.
  • Experiência em colaboração com estúdios, designers matemáticos e gerentes de produto.
  • Capacidade de propor soluções práticas quando um jogo não atende aos requisitos de certificação.
  • Inglês avançado (obrigatório).

Diferenciais

  • Experiência prévia com GLI, BMM, eCOGRA ou laboratórios similares.
  • Conhecimento do comportamento do consumidor brasileiro.
